description: Source code for a tool that reads TFFS partitions in AVM Fritz!Box devices, handling name-value storage, parsing entries, and displaying key-value pairs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading a TFFS file, parsing entries, and displaying key-value pairs based on user options.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options to configure the program's behavior.

methods.name: find_entry
methods.description: Searches for a specific entry in the TFFS buffer by ID.

methods.name: parse_key_names
methods.description: Parses the key name table from a TFFS entry.

methods.name: show_all_key_value_pairs
methods.description: Displays all key-value pairs found in the TFFS buffer.

methods.name: show_matching_key_value
methods.description: Displays the value for a specific key name.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: file_exist
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists.

methods.name: get_header_len
methods.description: Retrieves the length from a TFFS entry header, considering byte swapping.

methods.name: get_header_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID from a TFFS entry header, considering byte swapping.

methods.name: to_entry_header_id
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit name ID to a 16-bit entry header ID, considering byte swapping.

methods.name: get_walk_size
methods.description: Calculates the size to walk to the next entry, aligned to 4 bytes.

methods.name: print_entry_value
methods.description: Prints the value of a TFFS entry to stdout.

methods.name: parse_entry
methods.description: Parses a buffer segment into a TFFS entry structure.
